div.head: Abt 54.4
div.ab: Gif man goldfinger ofaslæhð, VI scill' gebete.
Gif man goldfinger ofaslæhð, VI scill' gebete.
Gif man goldfinger of aslæhð, VI sciƚƚ gebete.
Wenn jemand einen Goldfinger abhaut, büsse er 6 Schill.
If someone cuts off a gold-finger, let him pay 6 shillings.
If a man strikes off a ‘ring finger,’ he shall pay 6 shillings compensation.
If a person strikes off a goldfinger [i.e., ringfinger], let him pay [with] 6 shillings.
